dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>W-well? What do you think? Did I get the dance right?

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>You gotta go with the rhythm mooore. Gotta flow with
the flooow.
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)>Th-the flow? <wait(0.8)><$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,4)>...Like this?

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)>Hmmmmmm. <$cdef(27)>Lotad... <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,6)>Could it be that dancing maaaybe
makes you feel embaaarrassed?
<$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,840)>Urk!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>I feel yooouuu. It takes courage to do something you’re
not uuused to.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)>But I wanna know more about you and what you’re
feeliiing. <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>You gotta let your passion run freeeeee.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)>My...passion?

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Yeahhh. Take a good look at me...
<$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>I don’t look embaaarrassed at all, riiight?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Yeah, you look...really cool. And like you’re having fun.

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Riiight? You’ll stop caring what others think when you
just go aaall in on something...
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,6)>And that’s not my ooonly secret. I also just really like
myself when I’m daaancing!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>OK... I think I understand! I gotta show my passion.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>...How’s this?

<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$textsize(2)>Niiice! That’s passion!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>I could reeeaaally tell how you felt when you danced just
now.
You were having so much fun! <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>Just keep up the paaassion!
<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Yeah! I’ll do my best!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Yooo, <$cdef(27)><$cname(108)>! You’re always so cool and composed.
I wanna be like you!

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,6)>Heh... Is that so?
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>If you ask me, everyone else is just too excitable.

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Huh? Uh... <$cdef(27)><$cname(108)>, is that <$cdef(27)><$cname(69)> behind you? <$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>They’re
just sittin’ there starin’ at us, and it’s kinda creepy...
<$comcan(1)><$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>WHAT?! Where?
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,1)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)><$textsize(2)>BOO!!!</textsize>
<$comeff(2,11)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,823)><$voicel(2,10)><$textsize(2)>SCREEEEEE!!!</textsize>

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Whoa. Uh...sorry, yo. Didn’t expect ya to get so scared...
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I was thinkin’ you’d just stay cool and composed no matter
what, but I guess I got to see a new side of you just now!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Sableye. Your eyes sparkle greatly. Why? <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>It makes me a
small amount of jealous.

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I do not know. Maybe because I eat many sparkling gems.
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Glimmora. Your petals are very nice as well.
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh. Is it true? What do you find very nice?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Their gradient color is nice. And their smoothness. <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>But.
Mostly, I like the hunger they cause in my stomach.
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>The...hunger.

<$voicel(1,8)>The hunger. Yes. <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh, no. Drool. I cannot help it.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,2)><$textsize(0)>I must munch them.
<$emotion(2,58)><$voicel(2,5)>You must not. I am poison.

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>There is no problem. Poison does not affect me a
large amount.

<$comeff(2,14)>... ... ...
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>I have just remembered. I must do a thing. It is a very
important thing. It is for <$cdef(27)>.
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,7)>So, I must say goodbye for today. I must. Yes. Goodbye.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,23)>*sniffle* You bumped into me! It really hurt! Waaah!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, I’m sorry, but um...<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)> You’re faking crying, aren’t you?

<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>You can tell?! Wowww!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Yeah, I mean...it’s a vibe thing...

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)>Awww... Was it THAT easy to tell they weren’t real tears?
<$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,17)>I gotta get better at faking.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Well... I don’t know if it’s a good idea to try and trick
someone. If you get too carried away, you never know...
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>That “someone” might just gobble you up one of these days.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,17)>Come on, I just told you that fake crying isn’t a good ide—

<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,817)><$facial(2,10)><$comeff(2,2)><$kfacial(2)><$textsize(2)>WAAAHHH!!! YOU’RE SO SCARY!!!
AAAHHHNNNAAAHHH!!!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)>Uagh! Th-this is fake crying too, right? Right?!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Todaaay I’m going to tell you a stooory about a heated
battle I once had...
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>Yay! I wanna hear it! Tell me, tell me!

<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>All riiiiight. Here I go...
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Maaany moons ago, when I was still young, my home fell
under attack...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>So I jumped out all on my own and fought off muuultiple
opponents all by myself...
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Whoa, that’s awesome! What happened next?!

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,39)>Hahaaa. I see you are warming up to my stooory...
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>What was I talking about agaaaiiin? Oh yeah, my battle...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Just as I was about to breathe ooone final breath of fire to
end it, it suddenly started to raaaiiin...
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,10)>Uh-oh, sounds like a setback! What’d you do, then?!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Hmm... You’ve warmed up so muuuch that now you’re
starting to get heated. Let’s take a quick breeeaaak...
<$voicel(2,2)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>What?! Awww...

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>That cooled you down faaast, huh? Hahaha. Your emotions
are so obvious... <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>We can finish the story laaater...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)>But what happens next?! I gotta know!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Whoooaaa there... You’re getting really heated again. It’s
so difficult to control your fiiire...
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,9)>Kriii uuuuuune...

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Yooo, you have such a good sound, <$cdef(27)>Kricketune. It really,
like, pulls at my heartstrings ’n’ stuff.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>What’s the secret to makin’ such a pretty sound?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>Hmmm, good question. First, lemme hear your sound.

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Y-yeah, sure! <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,9)>Tot... Tot... Tot...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm... I dunno, yo. It just sounds like it lacks a bit of a
punch or somethin’.
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Ha! What’s wrong with that? Sounds cute to me!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)>Heyyy! Don’t make fun of my sound... This is a super
serious issue for me, yo!

<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,14)><$motion(2,807)>Whoa, sorry, pal! I didn’t mean it like that.
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,17)>See, I can’t make that sound anymore, so I’m kinda jealous
of ya.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>H-huh? YOU’RE jealous of ME?

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Ha! Guess the grass is always greener, huh?
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)>But it’s pretty fun tinkerin’ around to make your own tune.
If you can’t make a certain sound, try to work around it
and keep striving <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,806)>to produce one you DO want.
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>By the time you’re done, you’ll have your very own, unique
sound!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Yooo! Thanks, <$cdef(27)>Kricketune! I think I understand! <$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>I’m gonna
work hard to find my own ideal sound, just like you!

<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>Yooo, <$cdef(27)>Dartrix! You’re always so cool and composed and...
y’know, cool!
<$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,6)>Heh. You’re not wrong.
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Are you even like that in battle?!

<$emotion(2,13)><$voicel(2,5)>Of course. I start off by closely observing my opponents’
movements...
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Uh-huh, uh-huh.

<$voicel(2,7)>Then I instantly intuit where my opponent will be and what
they will do in the very next second. And then...
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,10)>I strike them down with a single blow!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>So cool!!!

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>That’s the secret to winning a battle without breaking a
sweat—it all comes down to using your head.

<$emotion(1,27)><$voicel(1,9)>My head?! I’m SO good at using my head, yo! <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>I once
knocked out 30 opponents in a row with just Headbutt!
<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Well... I guess there are lots of ways to use your head, huh.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Hey, bud. That’s a sturdy-lookin’ head ya got there.

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)>Wh-whoa... What’s with the sudden cooompliment? I think
I’m blushiiing...

<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>We gotta have a battle! Let’s see if your head is any match
against my pulverizing headbutt!
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,6)>Whaaat? H-hey... You’re making a scaaary face...
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,815)><$comeff(1,10)><$textsize(2)>HERE I COME! GRAHHHR!</textsize>
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)>H-heyyy...

<$comcan(1)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)>Uuugh, that really surpriiised me... And it kinda hurt?
It’s been a whiiile since something hurt me.

<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Oof...
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,18)>Can’t remember the last time I’ve felt this much pain...

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Ummm... Are we comparing who’s strooonger?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,10)>’Cause if so, I guess it’s myyy turn next? OK, I won’t
hold baaack...

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,803)>W-wait, no! Ummm...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Y-ya know what? I just remembered—it’s about time for
some grub... Guess we’ll have to stop here for today!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>Now then, I shall begin...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>Yeah! Bring it on, yo!
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Chato-to-tooo! ♪
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Cha!!! <wait(0.9)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Chato chato! ♪
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)>Chatotooo... TOT! ♪
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Not bad... Not bad at all! A most excellent jam session.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hehe! Don’t underestimate me, yo! And you were pretty
awesome yourself!

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,814)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>You’re doing well, <$cdef(27)>Riolu. I see definite improvement.
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Next, let’s work on refining your aura. Quietly now... Feel
the power inside you...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>*pant pant* Y-yes, Sensei!

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$emotion(2,14)>... ... ...Ah!
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>Heh heh, why don’t we get you something to eat, <$cdef(27)>Riolu.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>...Huh?
... ... ... *rumble*
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,9)>Oh!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Heh! It appears you’ve been concentrating so hard, you
didn’t even notice you were hungry.

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>I can’t believe you had to notice for me, Sensei... I’m
so embarrassed! <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>I’m really sorry!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>There’s no need to be embarrassed, <$cdef(27)>Riolu. Let’s get you
fed so you can start afresh on a full stomach!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Ah—one moment. We have nothing here to eat. So that
will be the next step in your training! Find some berries!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,1)>Do you think you can handle that, <$cdef(27)>Riolu?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)>Yes, Sensei! I’ll do my best so I can be like you someday!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)>Reading the mind of one’s opponent and then outwitting
them—that is the true essence of battle.

<$motion(1,800)><$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,46)>Yeah, you seem like you’d be pretty good at that sorta
thing. I’d love to figure out how to do that myself.
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Heh heh. Well then, how about a bit of training?
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,1)>Seriously? Heck yeah! Let’s do it!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,65)>In that case... In a moment, I will throw either a punch or
a kick. <$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)>Try to predict which it will be.

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Gotcha! OK, let’s see...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,815)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,20)>Got it! You’re gonna kick!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>I’m afraid not.
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,11)>Nooo! Thought I had it for sure...
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,806)><$comeff(1,6)>Well then, what do you predict I’ll unleash next?

<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,806)>I’ll definitely nail it this time!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,5)>You’re gonna...punch! Yeah, that’s gotta be it!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)>Unfortunately, the correct answer was Aura Sphere.
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,43)>Whoa, hey! No fair! That’s not a punch OR a kick!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Heh heh. As I said, the true essence of battle is to outwit
one’s opponent.
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Grgh... Guess I’m just not cut out for this!

...<$voicel(1,8)>Here I gooo.<$motion(1,850)>
<$voicel(1,4)>Ahhh.
<$emotion(2,15)>What the blazes?! <$voicel(2,7)>Th-that flame—!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>Hmmmmmm?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,48)><$facial(2,5)>Despite its magnificent size and appearance, you managed
to keep that fire from burning too hot...
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motionoff(2,666)>To produce—let alone control—a flame like that must
require a lot of skill.
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motionoff(1,666)>Hmmm? You think sooo?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>You’re an expert in the art of flame manipulation, aren’t
you? Please, share your secrets with me!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,803)><$comeff(1,14)>Weeell, there was a berry...

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,15)>A berry! I see, that never occurred to me.
<$motionoff(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Start by eating your favorite berry, relax both mind and
body—then concentrate. That’s it, yes?

<$motionoff(1,807)><$voicel(1,8)>Nooo... Uhhh...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>I wanted to kinda char a berry a bit befooore I ate it...<$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)>but I
accidentally burned it up insteeeaaad.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>If you bring me a berryyy I can teach you, though.

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)>I...I see. Of course, whenever you have the time, I would
love to learn from you!
<$voicel(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>Raaawr! Why’re you bigger than me?! It’s not fair!
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,6)>Not fair?
